recentItems.title: Bill Stulla Interview - Former Children's Television Host in Los Angeles
recentItems.description:
Paul Maher interview Bill Stulla (Known as Engineer Bill in TV) was a Children Television Host in a show called "Cartoon Express" in Los Angeles's KHJ-TV in 1954-1966, Along with Colonel Bleep and Pubic Domain Looney Tunes shorts. 

Bill also met Walt Disney in 1960 and share their love about Trains. 

For the Frank Zappa's Fans, He is credited as an inspiration in the liner notes for the 1966 Mothers of Invention album, Freak Out.

From Paul Maher's Children TV Archive.com, Go check out his website

Might be from the Late 70's or Early 80's, I'm not sure
